newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO held, talks thin ahead of New Year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO held, talks thin ahead of New Year.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices were assessed steady on Tuesday as discussions were reduced to a trickle ahead of the New Year holiday on Wednesday, traders said.
High sulphur 180-cst fuel oil levels were quoted on Monday at $123/$125 for January loading supplies.
Traders said prices were likely to stay steady this weak as cash fundamentals were healthy and talks were thin amid the holiday season and the usual year-end lull.
The local trader who purchased his cargo at $124 per tonne for early January loading on Monday may be there to buy more cargoes, traders said.
"We would consider buying more cargoes if the price is right," said the local trader.
"The market is also supported by some Chinese buying enquiries and the absence of new Middle East exports," one trader said.
In the swaps market, January traded at $121.25 per tonne and February at $117.25 a tonne, up between 25 and 50 cents from Monday.
Brokers said talks of buying interest from the local trader supported sentiment.
